formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p05_t1_uniform_backward_coefficients {k : Nat} (u computed c : Real) (products : Fin k -> Real) ... : exists theta0 thetaC thetaP, uniform (k+1)*u bounds and computed*(1+theta0)=c*(1+thetaC)-sum products_i*(1+thetaP_i)
formal_statement.plain_language: A residual bounded by (k+1)*u times the magnitudes of all sources can be distributed among exact sign-aligned source coefficients, each bounded by (k+1)*u.

informal_proof: Distribute the scalar residual over the sources in proportion to their magnitudes, using their signs. If their absolute-value sum is zero, the residual is zero and all coefficients can be zero.
informal_statement: The exact uniform-coefficient conversion used in Lemma 4.1 after its scalar residual estimate.
